title: Chorus contours
description: Faces drawn only as contours, arranged in stories: two faces face to face (home, every third story), a procession, generations, a round, a garden of turning flowers, a council, a performer and audience, a reflection, a crowd with one who turns away. Every beat the story steps on and every face is redrawn: contours glide to their new places, leaving faces unravel, new ones noodle in.
interaction: use laptop audio, a song or the mic  ·  wild slider  ·  N new story  ·  B new background  ·  tap to pause
